description: Find employers on BirJob by name, with how many open jobs each has and the URL of its birjob.com company page. Use this when the user names or asks about an employer (şirkət, company, компания), or wants the biggest hirers: without a query it lists the employers with the most open jobs in Azerbaijan. Do not use for the jobs themselves: pass the company's url to search_jobs as company.

page.description: Result page, 1 to 20 (default 1), 10 results a page. Past page 20, send the user to search_url.

query.description: Part of the company name: "Kapital", "PASHA", "Azercell", "SOCAR". Leave out for the employers with the most open jobs in Azerbaijan.

name: list_companies

url.description: The employer's page on birjob.com, with its open jobs.

title: Find employers on BirJob
